description: This file defines an Express router for the '/overview' endpoint within the analytics section of a backend API. It sets up middleware for authentication and tenant validation, includes route handlers for HEAD, OPTIONS, and GET requests to serve overview metrics, and exports the router.

methods.name: router.head
methods.description: Handles HEAD requests to '/overview' endpoint, sets custom headers and returns status 204.

methods.name: router.options
methods.description: Handles OPTIONS requests to '/overview' endpoint, responds with status 204.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/overview' endpoint, invokes the 'overviewMetrics' handler to return dashboard metrics.
